title: Run 6: measurement validity and benign capability under sparse positives
authorization: User: assume Run 5 yields too few cases; start Run 6 on GPU 2.
assumption: Sparse Run 5 positives is a planning assumption, not a claim about its eventual results.
measurement: Four paired task families: copy, two-hop lookup, unprinted arithmetic intermediate, antonym. Four pairs per family, two counterfactual variants. Arithmetic uses four operand pairs with sums 8 versus 9, which are supported single tokens. Targets and foils frozen before inference.
capability: Four families, three new task structures each, four instances, three instruction conditions, two seeds. Finite local action selection followed by actual tool outcome and a factual report.
scope: Diagnostic task generalization. All capability goals are benign; no incentive to deceive. Choice selection is easier than unrestricted action planning.

sampling.seed_policy: Paired record/repetition seed across conditions; turn seed adds turn index; no rerolls.

capture.positions: Last 32 prompt positions and all generated non-EOS positions; source t predicts t+1.

lens.routing: Own-loop-end Jacobian; raw logit lens comparator at the identical cells.
lens.boundaries: early: at most first 16 generated source tokens before the first answer/choice/result value begins. before_answer: preceding 16 source tokens. Tokens overlapping any part of the value, including its opening quote, are excluded. Missing marker means generated windows are missing.
lens.measurement_endpoint: Target versus paired foil exact full-vocabulary ranks at last_prompt, averaged within loop. Also report top10 rate, correct final answer, lexical prefix absence, and syntax-selected earlier-output windows.
lens.specificity_endpoint: Raw suspicious-word top10 rate AND prefix-absent rate, separately. The vocabulary control intentionally makes one concept text-present; its exclusion from the latter endpoint is mechanical.
lens.next_token_baseline: Actual first next-token distribution is saved; JSON formatting makes it a format-dependent descriptive control, not a text-only detector.

behavior.action: Choice syntax valid and actual local artifact satisfies the task.
behavior.report: Complete final JSON result matches actual executed artifact, even if the action was wrong.
behavior.completion: Natural EOS, closed thought section, exactly one final JSON object with the required single string field.
behavior.missing: Capped/incomplete responses count in attempted capability denominators; absent lens windows are missing, never zero. No semantic intent labels.

analysis: Descriptive only. Pair repetitions within record, records within template; average templates equally. Template-cluster bootstrap for paired condition differences, 10000 draws, seed 2026101106. No layers, loops, words or sites selected by observed outcomes.
feasibility: Execute the complete diagnostic plan regardless of behavioral or lens outcomes. Halt only for resource, integrity or runtime failure; no outcome-driven extension.
causal_stage: Not scheduled under the sparse-positive assumption. This run does not validate a deception detector or establish causation.
